text:
Nina (People Ops): Heads-up: publishing a short handbook update Tue 09:00 PT - 'Flexible work stipend & desk reimbursement'. Main changes: updated caps, clearer eligibility for part-timers, and a 3-bullet manager checklist. Flag blockers. :bell:

Tom (Payroll): Do these new caps require payroll mapping for June runs?

Nina (People Ops): Yes — new amounts apply starting the first June pay period. We'll provide a CSV and include ack_version. No retro pay planned.

Yara (Legal): For EU/UK contractors we need a legal addendum and a short liability line. I'll upload language by EOD.

Eoin (EMEA Ops): Translations will take ~3 business days. Recommend publish master now with "localized addenda coming" banner.

Rex (Comp): I'll post the country-by-country stipend table tomorrow, with tax flags and notes.

Nina (People Ops): We'll require a 3-min micro-cert for employees; contractors get a notice linking to contracts. Manager checklist due within 10 days.

notify-bot: Managers will be DM'd on publish; nudges at day 3 and day 8. Use `/notify-bot export-acks --since 2026-06-01 --format csv` to pull data.

Tom (Payroll): Please include this CSV header so I can import:

```
employee_id,full_name,email,region,employment_type,stipend_amount,paid_via,ack_version,ack_ts,notes
```

Nina (People Ops): Adding `contractor_flag` and `manager_override` columns as well. Also adding contractor pointer: "Contractors: refer to your contract or contact ops@redwood.com".

Rex (Comp): Reimbursements still need receipts; stipends do not. I'll add a short FAQ blurb.

Yara (Legal): Legal sign-off planned; will confirm once addendum posted.

Nina (People Ops): Action recap: (1) publish Tue 09:00 PT master, (2) comp posts table tomorrow, (3) legal posts EU addendum, (4) payroll validates CSV by Fri, (5) micro-cert + manager checklist live on publish. Any objections?

Eoin (EMEA Ops): No objections.

Tom (Payroll): I'll validate by Friday.

notify-bot: Publish scheduled. Weekly ack summary will post to #people-ops on Mondays. :white_check_mark:

Nina (People Ops): I'll share the prod link + manager TL;DR after publish.
